WITH grouped AS (
    SELECT 
        p.bats,
        COUNT(*) as appearance_count
    FROM appearances a
    INNER JOIN player p ON a.player_id = p.player_id
    WHERE p.bats != ''
    GROUP BY p.bats
)
SELECT 
    bats,
    appearance_count,
    appearance_count * 1.0 / SUM(appearance_count) OVER () as fraction,
    appearance_count * 1.0 / (SUM(appearance_count) OVER () / COUNT(*) OVER ()) as divided_by_average
FROM grouped
